newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica police seize cocaine, arrest eight.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica police seize cocaine, arrest eight.

text.p: Anti-drug police in Costa Rica have seized 200 kilograms (440 lbs) of cocaine and arrested eight people including the alleged leader of a notorious narco-trafficking gang, the Security Ministry said on Friday.
Police tracked the suspects for three months before confiscating the cocaine haul in the northwestern town of Liberia, in Costa Rica's Guanacaste province.
The drugs were loaded on trucks, probably for transport overland to the United States, the government said.
"The Security Ministry has succeeded in breaking up one of the most powerful gangs of drug traffickers operating in the country," the ministry said in a statement.
The alleged head of the gang, Costa Rican William Cubillo Diaz, and a Guatemalan driver were among the eight arrested.

The seizure is the second in two months. Last April Costa Rican police captured 370 kilograms (815 lbs) of cocaine in the same province near the Nicaraguan border. Police believe that haul was also destined for the United States.
